_comment: Row 536. Four regression mutants over the two things this cut asserts. M1/M2 restore the pre-fix 4-tuple on each chained fallback's disabled arm -- the exact shipped-configuration defect, one per link, because repairing only the ytdlp link moves the ValueError from runner_challenge.py:68 to :77 and the operator sees no difference. M3/M4 attack the OTHER half: that the fifth element is a measurement rather than padding. M3 pads it with `size` (the wrong fix that satisfies arity while claiming an already-present file was downloaded), M4 pins it to 0 (the wrong fix that satisfies arity while denying every real transfer). Each anchor occurs exactly once in bulk_downloader/runner_extractors.py, measured at candidate time.
